senses.gloss:
मेक मेक, अस्, m. (probably onomato-
poetic), a goat.

मेकल मेकल, अस्, m., N. of a mountain;
(आस्), m. pl., N. of a people, (also wrongly read
मेलक); (आ), f., N. of a river (= मेकल-कन्-
यका).
—मेकल-कन्यका or मेकल-कन्या, f.
‘daughter of Mekala,’ an epithet of the Narmadā
river.
—मेकलकन्यका-तट, N. of a district.
—मेकलाद्रि (˚ल-अद्˚), इस्, m. the Mekala moun-
tain.
—मेकलाद्रि-जा, f. ‘sprung from the Mekala
mountain,’ an epithet of the Narmadā river.

मेक्षण मेक्षण, अम्, n. (fr. मिक्ष्), Ved.
a wooden stick or spoon for stirring up the Caru or
taking small portions from it.
